title: Nest Homes: Himalayan Brand Identity & Collateral | Studio 1947
description: How Studio 1947 created the brand identity, color system, typography and collateral for Nest Homes, an eco-conscious homestay network across the Himalayas.
ogTitle: Nest Homes: Brand Identity & Collateral | Studio 1947
ogDescription: Branding, color psychology, and collateral design for Nest Homes across Darjeeling, Sikkim, and Himachal Pradesh.

hero.alt: The Nest Homes identity in motion: the woven nest emblem across signage, print and the mountain properties it belongs to

body: Nest Homes is a curated travel and homestay brand with 20+ properties across the Himalayan belt, spanning Darjeeling, Sikkim, and Himachal Pradesh. With over 1.5 Lakh+ happy travelers, 900+ Google Reviews (4.8★), and 1,000+ JustDial Reviews (4.8★), Nest Homes offers authentic, nature-led Himalayan stays and curated offbeat tours.

Nest Homes asked Studio 1947 to refresh its visual identity. We reimagined the logo, defined a full color and typography system, and designed print collateral and brand assets that reflect eco-conscious hospitality and the Himalayas.

sections.label: The Challenge
body: As Nest Homes grew across offbeat mountain destinations (including Sittong, Tinchuley, Chatakpur, Sandakphu, Kolakham, and Rishikhola), its brand identity needed a refresh to match its growing footprint.
The brand needed one visual language that captured both the calm of Himalayan rivers and the raw adventure of mountain forests. It also had to signal trust to modern, mobile-first travelers.

cards.title: Himalayan Harmony
cards.body: Bringing peaceful river valleys and rugged mountain wilderness together in one brand look.

cards.title: Collateral Uniformity
cards.body: Creating print and digital assets that scale across 20+ stay properties, tour packages, and offbeat itineraries.

cards.title: Trust & Eco-Consciousness
cards.body: Highlighting 150K+ happy guest reviews while placing the brand around sustainable, nature-focused experiences.

sections.heading: Logo Redesign & Anatomy of a Nest
sections.label: Thought Process & Emblem Design
body: We reworked the Nest Homes logo from an older blocky layout into one balanced circular emblem. The design draws directly on the anatomy of a nest: the organic, interlocking weave of twigs and grasses.

At the centre, two birds face each other in a protective, nurturing gesture inside a ring of woven branches, topped with elegant serif type. The symbol stands for sanctuary, warmth, safety, and homecoming in the Himalayan landscape.

sections.heading: Signage & Physical Spaces
sections.label: Brand Application
body: A strong brand identity has to move easily between screens and physical spaces. We built the Nest Homes emblem to work in both light and dark versions, and on exterior signage.
The circular emblem sits naturally on hanging wooden storefront signs, frosted window glass, and backlit entry markers at mountain retreats.

sections.heading: Colour Psychology: Harmony between Earth & Water
sections.label: Palette Architecture
body: Teal is the perfect colour for a tourist brand inspired by the Himalayas. It symbolises the harmony between earth and water. Its green side reflects the region's fertile valleys and forests, while the blue evokes the calm of rivers and lakes.

The darker tones carry the mystery and adventure of the wild jungles. Teal offers travelers both peace and adventure, and ties the brand to eco-conscious tourism and real, nature-led experiences in the Himalayas.

sections.heading: Typography System: Legibility & Warmth
sections.label: Visual Communication
body: Roboto & Roboto Serif give a modern, clean look that balances professionalism with warmth, ideal for a Himalayan tourist brand. They read easily in print and on screen, and reflect the brand's focus on nature, adventure, and sustainability.

cards.title: Roboto Serif: Editorial Warmth
cards.body: Used for main headlines, taglines ('Take Rest in your NEST'), and editorial callouts. It brings literary authority, heritage warmth, and a welcoming feel.

cards.title: Roboto Sans-Serif: Modern Clarity
cards.body: Used for body text, tour itineraries, price charts, and mobile UI, so everything stays legible on screens and in printed brochures.

sections.heading: Marketing Collateral, Brochures & Visiting Cards
sections.label: Print & Media Design
body: We designed a full set of print collateral: tri-fold brochures, business cards, and promotional poster mockups. It features vibrant hand-illustrated Himalayan artwork of the historic Darjeeling Toy Train, the iconic yellow mountain taxis, rolling tea gardens, and views of Kanchenjunga.
The collateral presents tour packages (Sandakphu 3N/4D, Darjeeling 4N/5D, Kurseong 2N/3D) alongside key trust signals, office details, and QR codes for quick digital enquiries.

cards.title: One brand, every surface
cards.body: Scattered promotional material became a single identity that holds up in print, on screen, and on a signboard outside a mountain property.

cards.title: Trust that travellers can see
cards.body: 1.5 lakh happy travellers and 900+ Google reviews now sit where a guest looks before booking, which turns browsing into direct bookings.

cards.title: A place in sustainable travel
cards.body: Nest Homes reads as a nature-first stay across Bengal, Sikkim and Himachal, alongside the travellers it wants to attract.
